taste.name: Depth lives in the objects, not the chrome
taste.trigger: When presenting apps whose whole identity is 3D, tactile and haptic
taste.decision: Chose flat page chrome (zero box-shadows, 4px radius only on buttons, pure-grey bands) over glass, gradients or shadowed cards
taste.reason: Because the rendered objects must be the only things with dimension; if the page itself had depth the products would stop reading as physical
evidence: 3D app icons and Artist Series cubes rendered at 1440×1440, 1:1

taste.name: Body copy at poster size
taste.trigger: When the message is a manifesto ('Playful software for life's boring routines') rather than documentation
taste.decision: Chose 36px/36px semibold body under 76px/76px headings over a conventional 16–18px body with 1.5 line-height
taste.reason: Because a reader should take in one thought per viewport, the way a poster is read from across a room; fewer words per screen is the price

taste.name: Catalog labels in mono
taste.trigger: When every app, skin and article needs metadata (name, tagline, number)
taste.decision: Chose JetBrains Mono 12px uppercase +0.5px 'SKNx009 / ISSUE 013' codes in #AAAAAA over marketing badges, tags or colored chips
taste.reason: Because a parts-catalog voice frames the apps as objects you collect, and the grey mono recedes so the grotesk headline stays the only loud thing
evidence: 12px appears on 66 text nodes, the most common size
mono caption triplet NAME / TAGLINE / SKU centered under each 1:1 image
footer links in the same 12px mono #B6B5B5

taste.name: Color bands instead of dividers
taste.trigger: When sectioning a 10,900px page with product, artist and blog content
taste.decision: Chose full-bleed color bands (#FFF, #ECECEC, #FFB200) with 100px internal padding and zero rules over hairline dividers, cards or whitespace-only gaps
taste.reason: Because a band change reads like turning a page, and the one amber band gives the scroll a landmark without putting color on a button
evidence: 100px is the third most common spacing value (26 nodes)
